question: Should OpenClaw merge this scoped providerless Crestodian model-provider handoff now, or fold it into the broader onboarding redesign work?
rationale: The patch is a user-facing onboarding/auth-provider behavior change with a protected maintainer label and overlapping open onboarding PRs, so automation should not choose the permanent product shape.

options.title: Merge the scoped handoff
options.body: Accept this PR after required checks finish, keeping installer/gateway-auth work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101901 and broader onboarding redesigns separate.

options.title: Fold into broader onboarding
options.body: Pause this PR and move the providerless model setup behavior into the larger guided onboarding branch if maintainers want one canonical onboarding change.

options.title: Defer the new prompt
options.body: Keep current deterministic fallback behavior until live fresh-provider onboarding proof or product direction is stronger.

recommendation.title: Merge the scoped handoff
recommendation.body: Accept this PR after required checks finish, keeping installer/gateway-auth work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101901 and broader onboarding redesigns separate.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is assigned on the PR and has the strongest recent setup/configuration ownership trail among the likely owners.
